cohort: Women aged 18-44 years who delivered a single live or stillbirth at ≥ 20 weeks of gestation from 2012 to 2019
finding: Pregnant women with a substance-related diagnosis experienced disproportionally higher odds of preterm and cesarean delivery compared to pregnant women without a substance-related diagnosis.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with a substance-related diagnosis experienced disproportionally higher odds of preterm and cesarean delivery compared to pregnant women without a substance-related diagnosis.
